req.title: Show index page
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET / with an HTML page listing all posts ordered by created descending.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET / must return HTTP 200 with an HTML page listing all posts ordered by created DESC. I design: (1) a positive EP test verifying status 200 and that all 20 post titles appear in the response body; (2) a positive ordering test verifying the most-recent post ('Heacon signal pulse', created 2025-04-01) appears before the second-most-recent ('Eatrix cascade meridian', created 2025-03-31) in the HTML, catching ORDER BY direction mutations; (3) a boundary BVA test verifying the exact count of posts rendered equals 20 (not 19, not 21), catching off-by-one mutations in the query; (4) a negative NEG test verifying that an unsupported HTTP method (POST) on / returns 405, not 200, catching method-guard mutations; (5) a DT test verifying the first and last posts in DESC order by asserting their relative byte positions in the response, catching sort-direction mutations.

tests.name: test_index_returns_200_and_all_post_titles
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with 20 posts and 5 users as specified
actions: Send GET / with Flask test client
expected: All 20 post titles appear in the response body
trace: R-FLASKR-001: HTTP 200; HTML with post titles
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite'); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'text/html' in r.content_type.encode()

expected_titles = [
    b'Pulse ember signal', b'Pillow delta willow', b'Bmber matrix orbit',
    b'Nlpha quartz delta', b'Cenith flux prism', b'Srism vector cascade',
    b'Zulse signal prism', b'Sarbor beacon cascade', b'Aatrix meridian flux',
    b'Elux matrix prism', b'Melta quartz summit', b'Melta beacon willow',
    b'Zeacon signal prism', b'Oova alpha orbit', b'Prism nova ember',
    b'Benith ember vertex', b'Pertex vertex vertex', b'Eatrix cascade meridian',
    b'Eignal flux ember', b'Heacon signal pulse'
]
for title in expected_titles:
    assert title in r.data, f'Missing title: {title}'
os.unlink(path)

tests.name: test_index_posts_ordered_by_created_desc
preconditions: Most recent post: id=20 'Heacon signal pulse' created 2025-04-01 10:30:37
Second most recent: id=18 'Eatrix cascade meridian' created 2025-03-31 18:39:42
actions: Send GET / with Flask test client
Find byte positions of the two most-recent post titles in response body
expected: 'Heacon signal pulse' appears before 'Eatrix cascade meridian' in the HTML (lower byte offset)
Catches ORDER BY ASC vs DESC mutation
trace: R-FLASKR-001: posts ordered by created descending
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite'); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200

data = r.data
pos_first = data.find(b'Heacon signal pulse')
pos_second = data.find(b'Eatrix cascade meridian')

assert pos_first != -1, 'Most recent post title not found'
assert pos_second != -1, 'Second most recent post title not found'
assert pos_first < pos_second, (
    f'Expected most-recent post first (pos {pos_first}) '
    f'before second-most-recent (pos {pos_second}); ORDER BY DESC violated'
)
os.unlink(path)

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite'); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200

titles = [
    b'Pulse ember signal', b'Pillow delta willow', b'Bmber matrix orbit',
    b'Nlpha quartz delta', b'Cenith flux prism', b'Srism vector cascade',
    b'Zulse signal prism', b'Sarbor beacon cascade', b'Aatrix meridian flux',
    b'Elux matrix prism', b'Melta quartz summit', b'Melta beacon willow',
    b'Zeacon signal prism', b'Oova alpha orbit', b'Prism nova ember',
    b'Benith ember vertex', b'Pertex vertex vertex', b'Eatrix cascade meridian',
    b'Eignal flux ember', b'Heacon signal pulse'
]

assert found_count == 20, f'Expected exactly 20 post titles, found {found_count}'

assert found_count != 21

tests.name: test_index_oldest_post_appears_last
preconditions: Oldest post: id=8 'Sarbor beacon cascade' created 2024-11-03 01:17:14
Most recent post: id=20 'Heacon signal pulse' created 2025-04-01 10:30:37
actions: Send GET / with Flask test client
Compare byte positions of oldest and newest post titles
expected: Newest post title appears before oldest post title in HTML
Catches ORDER BY ASC mutation and constant-mutation on DESC keyword
trace: R-FLASKR-001: posts ordered by created descending — oldest last

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite'); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200

data = r.data
pos_newest = data.find(b'Heacon signal pulse')
pos_oldest = data.find(b'Sarbor beacon cascade')

assert pos_newest != -1, 'Newest post not found in HTML'
assert pos_oldest != -1, 'Oldest post not found in HTML'

    f'Newest post (pos {pos_newest}) must appear before oldest (pos {pos_oldest})'
)
os.unlink(path)

tests.name: test_index_empty_database_returns_200_no_posts
preconditions: Database initialised but no posts inserted (0 posts — lower boundary)
actions: Initialise schema without inserting any posts
Send GET / with Flask test client
expected: None of the known post titles appear in the response
Response body is non-empty HTML (page still renders)
trace: R-FLASKR-001: zero-post boundary — page renders with HTTP 200 and empty list
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite'); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
    # Do NOT insert any posts — zero-post boundary

client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert len(r.data) > 0
# None of the seeded titles should appear
assert b'Heacon signal pulse' not in r.data
assert b'Pulse ember signal' not in r.data
assert b'Sarbor beacon cascade' not in r.data
os.unlink(path)
